text: Welcome to another Japan vlog!
This suitcase is about to fall apart
Today our first stop is Tokyo
We'll be exploring southern Hokkaido by air
Thank you to Japan Airlines for taking us on this journey!
This is JAL SKY SUITE III in Business Class
The seats come with a massage function 😂
Nice amenities like slippers and eye masks Free Wi-Fi for Business Class
But I'm most looking forward to the Japanese meal service
The prettiest inflight meal I've ever seen
Watching my favourite movie, Shaolin Soccer Ending the flight with a sake tasting
How do I describe the euphoric feeling of walking through Haneda Airport 😂 This time last year it was 38℃ (100.4°F)
Bracing ourselves...
Honestly it's really nice for early July!
we are home!
We're back where it all started at Tokyu Stay Ginza It feels like a full circle moment staying at this hotel in Tokyo If you guys watched our very first Tokyo vlog back in like 2022,
We stayed here for like over a month And it's good to be back at this hotel for 1 night Tomorrow we'll be heading to Sapporo!
It just so happens our friends are also in town, so we're grabbing a drink!
(We just saw them yesterday at the gym 😂)
A bar that reminds me of Potato Head in Bali 😂
With over 3,000 vinyl records
Very foreigner friendly
Love the Japanese city pop playlist
The vibes are immaculate, the cocktails are ok
An early start to the airport Ginza to Haneda Airport is around 25 minutes by taxi Today we'll be heading to Hokkaido by airplane
Japan Airlines' dedicated domestic First Class check-in counter
Check-in within 5 minutes through a private security lane
Popping into the lounge for a bite
Is it too early for a beer? 😅
We love watching the crew wave goodbye to travellers
Japan Airlines' new domestic First Class cabin seats
The flight is only 1.5 hours long
Complimentary seasonal meal service
The staff offered to help each guest take a photo
I love how they showcase Japan by using local ingredients
A cute handwritten note from the staff!
We were just here back in March
It's our third time in Hokkaido for the summer where the weather is perfect
We just arrived at Sapporo Station and now we're going to stay right across!
Trying a new hotel today!
This hotel is great if you plan to stay in the winter
Our room isn't ready yet so we'll go out for lunch
The hotel is connected to the underground tunnel that leads to Sapporo Station
Lavender lines all the streets of Sapporo
This is a very interesting location for a famous ramen shop
It feels like the Toronto suburbs
A ramen shop located inside a wholesale seafood market
Coffee on the right, ramen on the left
Next door is a coffee shop
Sam is queuing for ramen so I'll get a quick coffee Drinking this quickly because I can't bring it into the ramen shop
Nouilles is listed on Tabelog's "Ramen HOKKAIDO Top 100 Restaurants"
The ramen infuses French and Italian cooking techniques
The space is elegant and refined
The clear broth is a French consommé style using local chicken and pork
The broth isn't heavy and rich but it's perfect for the summer
The ramen is topped with its famous kelp foam
The noodles are paired with sous-vide duck and charcoal-grilled chicken Perhaps this is the most elegant bowl of ramen I've ever eaten!
On our way to a cafe, we stumbled upon a neighbourhood festival
You know you're in Hokkaido when you see crab legs casually being grilled
A cafe located upstairs
This is true!
Eccentric retro style interiors
This one is layered with soft cream, cornflakes, coffee jelly and topped with a whole pudding!
You can't go to Hokkaido without experiencing the night parfait culture
Many people go to Hokkaido for skiing in the winter But if you want to experience a cool summer, Hokkaido is the best!
A beautiful little shrine with decorations that change with the season
For summer, the theme is marine blue and white
Cute glass jellyfish wind chimes
The flower washing basin is also stunning
The shrine is about a 15 minute walk from Sapporo Station
We'll head back to the hotel to check-in first
This is the Essential Double room
This hotel opened in December 2025 so it feels very new Open-layout bathroom Standing shower and bathtub
Our room faces Sapporo Station and Daimaru
We'll spend the rest of the evening walking around the malls
Please watch our previous Hokkaido vlogs if you want in-depth shop introductions!
We will leave all the names of the shops on the top right
Tried on a few new tops for the summer
These are a few of my go-to homeware shops in Sapporo Station:
I usually come here to buy souvenirs but we'll just get a soft cream this time
A soup curry joint we always go to While we eat, here's a few photos from Sapporo!
Time for bed because we have a flight to catch in the morning!
Another early morning to the local airport
It'll take 20 minutes to reach the airport
Okadama is Sapporo's domestic airport
We'll be flying with Hokkaido Air System (HAC) today!
It's the regional JAL group airline that flies with propeller-type airplanes
The plane has its own merch
They also fly to other parts of Hokkaido like Rishiri, Kushiro and Memanbetsu
It feels like I'm flying a private jet 😂
The staff hand out candy with a sweet note
Wow you can see the famous star-shaped Goryokaku Park from above!
